verdict.rationale: Honeycomb supports Triggers and SLOs that fire alerts when defined thresholds are crossed, routing notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, Teams, or custom webhooks, and webhooks can carry JSON payloads for custom automated actions — this is rule-based automation, but it is alerting/notification-centric rather than a general-purpose 'if event then arbitrary action' automation engine. missing for 10: evidence of a broader rules/automation engine beyond triggers+SLO alerts (e.g., conditional branching, multi-step workflows, native action execution beyond webhook notification), and independent/hands-on confirmation that triggers reliably fire complex automated actions in production.
